_launch: THE launch switch (one line, in the launch PR). false = staging: canonical = the staging host (urls.staging, or env STAGING_URL for a private staging server), every page noindex, robots.txt disallows all, no sitemap.xml, X-Robots-Tag noindex. true = live: canonical https://uniquespahouse.com, pages indexable, production robots.txt + sitemap.xml; *.pages.dev previews stay noindex. Env LAUNCH=1/0 overrides for a test build; PREVIEW=1 always builds staging.

gift_offer._note: Katy's holiday gift card choice (gift kit decision 1, APPROVALS Q50). option: "A" = no offer (default; cards at menu prices, nothing shows). "B" = $25 off a $225 eGift card (pay $200). "C" = a $25 promo card for buyers who spend $200+. Setting B or C IS the approval: do it only after the Square set-up, one test purchase and the lawyer check. B and C need starts and ends (YYYY-MM-DD, Los Angeles dates, inclusive; a real end date, never extended after posting). C also needs c_send_days (a number, e.g. 7), c_promo_valid (the words after 'Promo card valid', e.g. "January 4 to February 28, 2027") and c_limits (one full sentence, e.g. "One per buyer.", or "" for none); the lawyer checks that line. A production build fails while a required field is missing; PREVIEW shows [brackets]. Env GIFT_OFFER / GIFT_STARTS / GIFT_ENDS override for test builds. The gift page, the home offers band, the policies gift card section and the $225 tile badge all follow this one field. Wording lives in offers.json "holiday-egift-2026".options.

_square_gift_name: Gift kit fix 6 / Q54. The business name Square's gift card page shows. While set, /gift-cards says 'Our secure gift card page is run by Square. It shows the name Unique Massage LLC.' under the hero button. Set to null once the business is renamed in Square.
